G1.criterion: D1, delta 1 ms: NCP 2 costs less per exchange than NCP 1.0.1, for each host language, size, and thread count, in every block

G2.criterion: D1, delta 1 ms: the median of the 6 median costs per exchange of ncp2-rs is at most 0.10 ms

G3.criterion: D4: every ncp2-rs-spikes configuration, Brunel with 10,000 neurons at 5 ms included, has a median cost per exchange of at most 0.15 ms

G4.criterion: every run is valid and the recorded counts agree across arms

G5.criterion: the recorder totals equal those of protocols 2 and 3 for every configuration and block that both ran

G6.criterion: D1, delta 1 ms: the median overhead of NCP 2 is lower than that of NCP 1.0.1, for each host language, size, and thread count, in every block

G7.criterion: D4: every ncp2-rs-spikes configuration has a median overhead of at most 0.15 ms
